nodes.label: causal inference
nodes.def: reasoning about cause-effect relationships enabling prediction of consequences given observed causes

nodes.label: consistency
nodes.def: A reasoning task verifying that an ontology has no contradictory axioms that would eliminate all possible models.

nodes.label: counterfactual reasoning
nodes.def: reasoning about hypothetical alternative scenarios and their outcomes differing from actual observed events

nodes.label: tbox
nodes.def: The terminological box — the schema-level component of a knowledge base defining classes, properties, and their relations.

nodes.label: abox
nodes.def: The assertional box — the instance-level component of a knowledge base containing ground assertions about individuals.

nodes.label: annotation property
nodes.def: A property type for attaching metadata (labels, comments, deprecated flags) without affecting reasoning.

nodes.label: application ontology
nodes.def: A concrete ontology tailored for a specific software application, integrating and constraining reference and domain ontologies.

nodes.label: axiom
nodes.def: A logical statement in an ontology taken as fundamental truth, constraining what inferences and interpretations are valid.

nodes.label: backward chaining
nodes.def: An inference strategy starting from a query goal and recursively applying rules backwards to find supporting facts.

nodes.label: blank node
nodes.def: An anonymous resource in RDF without a stable IRI, used for existential variables or intermediate blank graph nodes.

nodes.label: cardinality restriction
nodes.def: A class restriction specifying exact, minimum, or maximum number of values a property can take for class members.

nodes.label: class
nodes.def: A concept in an ontology representing a set of entities that share common characteristics, forming the taxonomic backbone.

nodes.label: class assertion
nodes.def: statement asserting that an individual entity belongs to a specific class in the ontology classification system

nodes.label: classification
nodes.def: The process of organizing entities into classes based on shared characteristics, a core activity in ontology engineering.

nodes.label: coherence
nodes.def: The quality property of an ontology where all defined classes can have at least one instance without violating constraints.

nodes.label: concept hierarchy
nodes.def: organization of concepts in an ontology forming IS-A taxonomic relationships with superclass and subclass relations

nodes.label: concept similarity
nodes.def: metric quantifying the degree of semantic relatedness between two concepts based on shared attributes and relationships

nodes.label: confidence scoring
nodes.def: assignment of probability or confidence values to knowledge graph triples indicating reliability of each fact

nodes.label: constraint
nodes.def: A logical condition restricting valid states of a knowledge graph, violated instances indicating data quality issues.

nodes.label: constraint satisfaction
nodes.def: enforcement of logical rules and cardinality constraints ensuring knowledge graph consistency and validity

nodes.label: coreference
nodes.def: The relationship between different expressions referring to the same entity, central to entity resolution and data integration.

nodes.label: datatype property
nodes.def: A property type in OWL whose value is a literal datatype, attaching data values to entities.

nodes.label: domain ontology
nodes.def: An ontology capturing the concepts and relations specific to a particular subject area or application domain.

nodes.label: entity linking
nodes.def: process of connecting textual entity mentions to their corresponding nodes in a knowledge graph disambiguating meaning

nodes.label: evidence aggregation
nodes.def: process of combining evidence from multiple sources to determine the overall confidence in a knowledge assertion

nodes.label: forward chaining
nodes.def: An inference strategy applying rules repeatedly from premises to conclusions until no new facts can be derived.

nodes.label: graph pattern
nodes.def: A template of triple patterns with variables used in SPARQL queries to match and extract subgraphs from knowledge graphs.

nodes.label: named individual
nodes.def: An individual entity that is explicitly named with an IRI, as distinguished from anonymous blank nodes.

nodes.label: property assertion
nodes.def: triple asserting a specific relationship between two individuals or an individual and a literal value

nodes.label: qualified cardinality
nodes.def: A cardinality restriction in OWL 2 specifying the exact number of values from a specified class for a given property.

nodes.label: realization
nodes.def: The automated reasoning task of determining the most specific classes that apply to each individual in a knowledge base.

nodes.label: satisfiability
nodes.def: A reasoning task determining whether an ontology or class description can have any valid model satisfying all axioms.

nodes.label: semantic relation
nodes.def: An abstract typed connection between concepts or entities capturing meaningful domain-relevant associations.

nodes.label: subclass of
nodes.def: A taxonomic relation stating that one class is more specific than (a specialization of) another class.

nodes.label: taxonomy
nodes.def: A hierarchical classification structure organizing concepts from general to specific through subclass/superclass relationships.

nodes.label: validation
nodes.def: The checking of a knowledge graph against defined constraints to identify violations indicating errors or inconsistencies.

nodes.label: abductive reasoning
nodes.def: inference process that derives the most likely explanation for observed facts given available knowledge

nodes.label: description logic
nodes.def: The decidable fragment of first-order logic underpinning OWL, balancing expressive power with tractable reasoning.

nodes.label: disjoint class
nodes.def: ontology axiom ensuring instances of one class cannot simultaneously belong to another specified class

nodes.label: disjoint union
nodes.def: A logical axiom stating that a class is exactly the union of a collection of pairwise-disjoint classes.

nodes.label: disjoint with
nodes.def: A logical constraint stating that two classes have no common instances, enforcing mutual exclusivity in domain models.

nodes.label: distant supervision
nodes.def: weak supervision technique using knowledge graph to generate training labels for relation extraction from text

nodes.label: dl safe rule
nodes.def: A rule in OWL 2 RL/RDF that is restricted to ensure decidability and compatibility with description logic semantics.

nodes.label: domain
nodes.def: The constraint specifying which classes an entity must belong to when it appears as the subject of a given property.

nodes.label: domain range
nodes.def: constraints defining which entity types can appear as subject or object of a given property in an ontology

nodes.label: entailment
nodes.def: A logical consequence relationship where one set of statements necessarily follows from another set given the formal semantics.

nodes.label: entity
nodes.def: A real or abstract thing represented as a node in a knowledge graph, identified by a unique IRI and having properties and relationships.

nodes.label: entity disambiguation
nodes.def: process of determining which specific real-world entity a text mention refers to when multiple candidates exist

nodes.label: entity representation learning
nodes.def: learning continuous vector embeddings for entities capturing their semantic properties and graph neighborhood

nodes.label: entity resolution
nodes.def: The task of identifying when multiple entity identifiers refer to the same real-world object, also called deduplication.

nodes.label: entity typing
nodes.def: task of assigning semantic types and classes to entities determining what categories they belong to in the ontology

nodes.label: equivalent class
nodes.def: A logical axiom declaring two class expressions to denote the same set of entities in an ontology.

nodes.label: equivalent property
nodes.def: A logical axiom declaring two properties to have identical semantics and extensions in an ontology.

nodes.label: existential restriction
nodes.def: A class restriction requiring that instances have at least one value for a specified property from a specified class.

nodes.label: fact checking
nodes.def: task of verifying the truthfulness of factual claims using knowledge graphs as a source of verified knowledge

nodes.label: formal ontology
nodes.def: An explicit specification of a conceptualization using a formal logic, enabling computational reasoning about domain structure.

nodes.label: foundational ontology
nodes.def: A top-level ontology supplying core metaphysical categories and relations for building domain ontologies on top of.

nodes.label: functional property
nodes.def: A property axiom stating that each entity can have at most one distinct value for this property.

nodes.label: graph
nodes.def: An abstract mathematical structure composed of nodes (vertices) and edges (connections) underlying all knowledge graph representations.

nodes.label: graph database
nodes.def: database management system optimized for graph storage and traversal operations enabling efficient knowledge graph queries

nodes.label: graph embedding
nodes.def: A learned low-dimensional vector representation of graph elements preserving structural and semantic proximity information.

nodes.label: graph neural network
nodes.def: A neural architecture designed to operate directly on graph-structured data, learning representations for nodes and edges.

nodes.label: graph query language
nodes.def: language designed for expressing pattern matching and traversal operations over graph-structured knowledge

nodes.label: graph traversal
nodes.def: The algorithmic process of visiting nodes and edges in a knowledge graph following defined patterns or strategies.

nodes.label: hierarchy
nodes.def: A parent-child tree structure imposing ordering among entities, fundamental to class taxonomies and part-whole relations.

nodes.label: hybrid reasoning
nodes.def: A reasoning approach combining multiple inference techniques such as description logic reasoning with rule-based logic programming.

nodes.label: indexing
nodes.def: The creation of auxiliary data structures enabling fast retrieval of triples matching given patterns in a triple store.

nodes.label: individual
nodes.def: A concrete instance of a class in an ontology, representing a specific entity in the domain rather than a type.

nodes.label: inductive learning
nodes.def: A learning setting where the model generalizes to entirely unseen entities not present during training.

nodes.label: inference
nodes.def: The process of deriving new implicit knowledge from explicit statements using logical rules and reasoning mechanisms.

nodes.label: inference engine
nodes.def: reasoning system that derives new implicit knowledge from explicit facts using logical rules and ontology constraints

nodes.label: instance of
nodes.def: A membership relation connecting an individual entity to the class it belongs to.

nodes.label: inverse functional property
nodes.def: A property axiom stating that the inverse of a property is functional, enabling inference of identity from property values.

nodes.label: inverse property
nodes.def: A logical axiom declaring that two properties are the mutual converse of each other in a relationship pair.

nodes.label: iri
nodes.def: Internationalized Resource Identifier — the global identifier standard for resources in the semantic web, replacing the older URI spec.

nodes.label: irreflexive property
nodes.def: A property axiom stating that no entity can relate to itself via the specified property.

nodes.label: json ld
nodes.def: JSON for Linked Data — a JSON-based serialization for RDF designed for ease of use by web developers.

nodes.label: knowledge base
nodes.def: A persistent storage system for structured knowledge, combining a knowledge graph with an inference engine and query interface.

nodes.label: knowledge completion inference
nodes.def: specialized inference focused on predicting missing facts by reasoning over existing knowledge graph structure

nodes.label: knowledge curation
nodes.def: ongoing process of reviewing validating updating and correcting knowledge stored in the graph

nodes.label: knowledge embedding
nodes.def: A vector representation of entities and relations in a knowledge graph learned to satisfy relational constraints geometrically.

nodes.label: knowledge graph
nodes.def: A structured representation of knowledge as a graph of entities (nodes) and their relationships (edges), enabling semantic querying and inference over interconnected data.

nodes.label: knowledge graph augmentation
nodes.def: process of enhancing an existing knowledge graph with additional facts entities or relations from external sources

nodes.label: knowledge graph completion
nodes.def: The task of automatically inferring missing facts in a knowledge graph to improve its coverage and utility.

nodes.label: knowledge graph construction
nodes.def: end-to-end process of building a knowledge graph from raw data sources including extraction integration and curation

nodes.label: knowledge graph embedding
nodes.def: specific embedding technique that projects knowledge graph components into continuous vector representations

nodes.label: knowledge graph fusion
nodes.def: process of merging multiple knowledge graphs into a unified graph resolving conflicts and eliminating duplicates

nodes.label: knowledge graph indexing
nodes.def: creation of efficient data structures enabling fast lookup and retrieval of entities and relations in the graph

nodes.label: knowledge graph linking
nodes.def: establishment of cross-references between entities in different knowledge graphs forming a linked knowledge network

nodes.label: knowledge graph query optimization
nodes.def: techniques for efficiently executing complex queries over large-scale knowledge graphs using indexing and planning

nodes.label: knowledge graph revision
nodes.def: process of modifying the knowledge graph to correct errors incorporate new information or adapt to changing knowledge

nodes.label: knowledge graph schema learning
nodes.def: automatic discovery of structural patterns and typing schemas from entity relationships in the graph

nodes.label: knowledge graph storage
nodes.def: physical organization of knowledge graph data in storage systems including indexing partitioning and caching strategies

nodes.label: knowledge ontology matching
nodes.def: process of aligning entities and relations between a knowledge graph and an external ontology reference schema

nodes.label: knowledge representation
nodes.def: The field of study concerned with how to formally encode knowledge so that computer systems can reason about it.

nodes.label: link neighbor
nodes.def: An entity adjacent to a given entity via one or more edges in a knowledge graph, forming the local neighborhood context.

nodes.label: link prediction
nodes.def: The task of inferring missing or likely future relationships between entities in a knowledge graph.

nodes.label: linked data
nodes.def: A set of best practices for publishing and interlinking structured data on the web using RDF and HTTP IRIs.

nodes.label: literal
nodes.def: A raw data value (string, number, date) in an RDF triple, as opposed to a reference to another entity via IRI.

nodes.label: literal value
nodes.def: data value like string number date or boolean attached to entities as property objects in knowledge representation

nodes.label: materialization
nodes.def: The pre-computation and storage of all inferred facts derivable from explicit knowledge, trading space for query speed.

nodes.label: module extraction
nodes.def: The extraction of a minimal relevant subset of an ontology satisfying all axioms relevant to a given signature of interest.

nodes.label: multi hop reasoning
nodes.def: The ability to traverse and compose multiple relational steps in a knowledge graph to derive complex inferred conclusions.

nodes.label: n triples
nodes.def: A line-oriented RDF serialization format where each triple appears on a single line as subject predicate object separated by spaces.

nodes.label: named entity recognition
nodes.def: NLP task of locating and classifying named entities in text into predefined categories like person organization location

nodes.label: named graph
nodes.def: An RDF graph identified by an IRI, enabling provenance tracking, access control, and multi-context knowledge representation.

nodes.label: namespace
nodes.def: A logical grouping of related identifiers under a common prefix, disambiguating terms and providing context for schema definitions.

nodes.label: neural symbolic
nodes.def: An approach integrating neural network learning with symbolic reasoning for enhanced knowledge graph completion and inference.

nodes.label: object
nodes.def: The third element of an RDF triple — the value or entity that is the target of the predicate assertion.

nodes.label: object property
nodes.def: A property type in OWL whose value is another individual entity, expressing binary relations between resources.

nodes.label: ontology
nodes.def: A formal explicit specification of a shared conceptualization, defining concepts, categories, properties, and relations within a domain of discourse.

nodes.label: ontology alignment
nodes.def: The result of ontology matching — a set of mappings establishing equivalence, subsumption, or other relations between aligned entities.

nodes.label: ontology engineering
nodes.def: The discipline of building, maintaining, and evolving ontologies, encompassing methodology, tools, and best practices.

nodes.label: ontology evaluation
nodes.def: The systematic assessment of ontology quality along dimensions including correctness, completeness, and coherence.

nodes.label: ontology import
nodes.def: The mechanism in OWL for one ontology to formally incorporate the axioms and declarations from another referenced ontology.

nodes.label: ontology learning
nodes.def: The automated or semi-automated extraction of ontology components from data sources such as text or structured data.

nodes.label: ontology matching
nodes.def: The automated process of finding semantic correspondences between entities from different ontologies.

nodes.label: ontology merge
nodes.def: The process of combining two or more ontologies into a unified ontology based on established alignments.

nodes.label: ontology module
nodes.def: extractable self-contained subset of an ontology that preserves semantic consistency and can be shared independently

nodes.label: ontology pattern
nodes.def: reusable solution template for modeling common domain concepts like part-whole temporal events and qualifiers

nodes.label: ontology population
nodes.def: The process of adding instance-level assertions to an ontology, filling the ABox with real or synthesized individuals.

nodes.label: ontology quality
nodes.def: A multi-dimensional measure of how well an ontology meets its intended purpose and adheres to structural best practices.

nodes.label: ontology reasoning
nodes.def: logical inference performed by a reasoner to deduce implicit knowledge from ontology axioms and asserted facts

nodes.label: ontology versioning
nodes.def: The management of changes to an ontology over time, tracking revisions and maintaining backward compatibility.

nodes.label: owl
nodes.def: Web Ontology Language — the W3C standard for formal ontology definition supporting rich logical constraints and automated reasoning.

nodes.label: owl 2
nodes.def: The second version of OWL with extended expressiveness including qualified cardinality, datatype facets, and property chain axioms.

nodes.label: path
nodes.def: A sequence of connected entities and relationships traversed through a knowledge graph from an origin to a destination node.

nodes.label: path querying
nodes.def: traversal operation that finds sequences of edges connecting entities enabling multi-hop navigation in the graph

nodes.label: predicate
nodes.def: The property or relation type that connects subject to object in an RDF triple, linking entities via typed relationships.

nodes.label: property
nodes.def: A relation type that links entities or connects entities to literal values, forming the edges of the knowledge graph.

nodes.label: property chain
nodes.def: An axiom in OWL 2 stating that a composed property equals a chain of two or more constituent properties.

nodes.label: property hierarchy
nodes.def: taxonomy of relations organizing properties by generality with subproperties inheriting domain and range constraints

nodes.label: provenance
nodes.def: Metadata about the origin, authorship, and chain of custody of knowledge graph triples and entities.

nodes.label: quad
nodes.def: An extension of an RDF triple with a fourth element identifying the named graph, enabling context-annotated statements.

nodes.label: query answering
nodes.def: task of answering natural language or structured questions by retrieving and reasoning over knowledge in the graph

nodes.label: query federation
nodes.def: A technique for executing SPARQL queries across multiple distributed knowledge graphs as if they were a single unified graph.

nodes.label: query optimization
nodes.def: The improvement of SPARQL query execution plans to minimize response time and resource consumption.

nodes.label: range
nodes.def: The constraint specifying which classes or datatypes apply to the value of a given property when used on an entity.

nodes.label: rdf
nodes.def: Resource Description Framework — the foundational W3C standard data model for representing knowledge as subject-predicate-object triples.

nodes.label: rdf schema
nodes.def: The vocabulary definition language extending RDF with class/property hierarchies, domains, ranges, and typing primitives.

nodes.label: rdfa
nodes.def: RDFa — a specification for embedding RDF assertions within HTML and XML documents using attributes.

nodes.label: reasoning
nodes.def: The systematic application of logical rules to a knowledge graph to deduce new facts, check consistency, and classify entities.

nodes.label: reasoning engine
nodes.def: A software system implementing inference algorithms to derive implicit consequences from explicit knowledge graph axioms.

nodes.label: reflexive property
nodes.def: A property axiom stating that every entity necessarily relates to itself via the specified property.

nodes.label: relation
nodes.def: A typed connection between two entities in a knowledge graph, expressing how one thing relates to another.

nodes.label: relation extraction
nodes.def: natural language processing task of identifying and classifying relationships between entities mentioned in text

nodes.label: relation typing
nodes.def: task of categorizing relations into types or subtypes based on their semantic meaning and structural role

nodes.label: restriction
nodes.def: A anonymous class describing a set of individuals by constraining property values they must or may have.

nodes.label: rule
nodes.def: An if-then logical statement encoding domain knowledge that can derive new triples from matching antecedent patterns.

nodes.label: rule learning
nodes.def: automatic discovery of logical rules and patterns expressed as Horn clauses from knowledge graph examples

nodes.label: schema
nodes.def: The structural blueprint defining entity types, relationship types, constraints, and validation rules for a knowledge graph.

nodes.label: semantic role
nodes.def: linguistic description of the function an entity plays in a relation such as agent patient instrument or location

nodes.label: semantic web
nodes.def: The vision of a machine-readable web of data where information has well-defined meaning through shared ontologies and standards.

nodes.label: serialization
nodes.def: The conversion of an RDF graph into a standardized text or binary format for storage and exchange.

nodes.label: shacl
nodes.def: Shapes Constraint Language — a W3C standard for validating RDF data against sets of structural and logical constraints.

nodes.label: shapes
nodes.def: The declarative constraints in SHACL specifying the valid structure and value constraints for RDF data conforming to a graph.

nodes.label: source attribution
nodes.def: association of knowledge graph triples with their originating sources enabling verification and trust assessment

nodes.label: sparql
nodes.def: The W3C standard query language for RDF knowledge graphs, supporting pattern matching, filters, aggregation, and subqueries.

nodes.label: sparql update
nodes.def: The extension to SPARQL for modifying, inserting, and deleting triples within RDF graphs using update operations.

nodes.label: staleness detection
nodes.def: identification of knowledge graph facts that may be outdated or no longer accurate in current context

nodes.label: subgraph matching
nodes.def: process of finding occurrences of a query graph pattern within a larger knowledge graph

nodes.label: subject
nodes.def: The first element of an RDF triple — the entity about which a statement is made, always an IRI or blank node.

nodes.label: swrl
nodes.def: Semantic Web Rule Language — a W3C submission extending OWL with Horn-like rules for expressing additional inferential knowledge.

nodes.label: symmetric property
nodes.def: A property axiom stating that if entity A relates to B, then B also relates to A via the same property.

nodes.label: tableau reasoner
nodes.def: A reasoning algorithm for description logics based on constructing and manipulating a completion graph to test satisfiability.

nodes.label: temporal knowledge graph
nodes.def: knowledge graph augmented with temporal annotations specifying when facts hold and when relationships are active

nodes.label: temporal reasoning
nodes.def: inference process that accounts for time dimensions when facts become valid expire or evolve in the knowledge graph

nodes.label: transductive learning
nodes.def: A learning setting where the model observes all training and test entities but not their labels during training.

nodes.label: transitive property
nodes.def: A property axiom stating that if A relates to B and B relates to C, then A relates to C through the same property.

nodes.label: triple
nodes.def: A basic unit of RDF data consisting of subject-predicate-object that expresses a single atomic assertion about the world.

nodes.label: triple store
nodes.def: A specialized database system optimized for storing, indexing, and querying RDF triples at scale.

nodes.label: ttl
nodes.def: TTL (Turtle) — the common file extension for Turtle-format RDF files, used throughout the semantic web ecosystem.

nodes.label: turtle
nodes.def: Terse RDF Triple Language — a human-readable serialization format for RDF using prefix notation and nested expressions.

nodes.label: universal restriction
nodes.def: class description ensuring that all related entities through a property must satisfy given conditions

nodes.label: upper ontology
nodes.def: A high-level ontology providing foundational categories (entity, event, time, space) that bridge domain-specific ontologies.

nodes.label: uri
nodes.def: Uniform Resource Identifier — the addressing scheme for resources on the web, forming the basis for naming graph elements.

nodes.label: vocabulary
nodes.def: A defined set of terms, their meanings, and relationships that provides the schema layer for a knowledge graph or ontology.
